core_finding: IREA was not the lender or credit holder. It was SAREB's named financial adviser on Project Meridian in 2014 and separately a prospective Sun Park/LPB debt adviser in September 2017. Colliers is the post-2018 corporate-continuity and potential current records-custody route to confirm.
